column1: Engagement: Brightwater Logistics Inc. - FY2025 Financial Statement Audit

column4: Bank reconciliations for all operating and payroll accounts as of June 30, 2025, with the June bank statements and outstanding check listing.
For all vendor disbursements greater than $25,000 during the fiscal year, please provide the vendor invoice, evidence of approval and proof of payment (check copy or ACH remittance).
Complete vendor master listing as of year end including vendor name, address, tax ID and date added. Please flag the vendors that were added during FY25.
Report of corporate card transactions over $75 with no receipt attached, for the period July 1, 2024 - June 30, 2025.
Payroll registers for two pay periods (we will select) and reconciliation of total payroll expense to the general ledger.
System-generated listing of users with administrator rights in the corporate card / expense management system, including role and date access was granted.
Any analysis performed to identify duplicate vendor payments (same vendor, same amount or same invoice number) during the year, and support for any refunds received.
Fixed asset rollforward for the year with invoices for all additions over $10,000.
Listing of corporate card transactions flagged as policy violations, including split transactions and purchases at restricted merchant categories (MCC). Q4 only (April 1, 2025 - June 30, 2025).
